title: Things to Do in Boone NC This Weekend | Fall 2026
excerpt: Fall is still showing off in the NC High Country, and this weekend is packed with reasons to love Boone — from mountain trails to local markets and holiday kickoffs. If you've ever thought about making this area home, there's no better time to come see what all the fuss is about.
